groups.problem: Direct indexing of installer metadata can crash the installation pipeline when sender or login is missing.
groups.rationale: Both flag the same metadata access and request guarded lookup that treats missing installer information as verification failure.

groups.problem: Unhandled exceptions during GitHub token exchange and user lookup produce a 500 instead of the integration failure page.
groups.rationale: Both identify the same unprotected safe_urlopen and get_user_info calls and propose exception handling around the OAuth exchange and lookup.
